**AGC-JH-B03 r2 is complete.** On the circle \(|z-36|=9\) at physical time zero, the canonical 24-site Jacobi head **overestimates the squared half-gap** of the counted pair. Writing \(D_F\) for the complete theta field’s squared half-gap, the signed contour calculation certifies

\[
-4.95800\times10^{-8}<D_F-D_{24}<-4.95742\times10^{-8}.
\]

Both fields have exactly two roots inside radius 8, giving a buffer of 1 to the contour. Their moduli exceed \(1.43319\times10^{-5}\) throughout the verified collar. The signed first variation was \(J\approx-4.9577105356\times10^{-8}\). After accounting for the full source, all 23 Jacobi links, rounding, and motion of the pair center, the remainder was below \(2.8467\times10^{-12}\).
